signature.name: Baseline rules
signature.what: Faint horizontal rules at the body line height that show through section edges.
signature.build: Draw the rules with a repeating-linear-gradient every calc(var(--lh-body) * 1rem) in var(--border) and give body text the same line height so lines sit on them. Stop the pattern at section boundaries with a solid band so it reads as ruled paper, not texture.

signature.name: Tabular hero numeral
signature.what: One oversized tabular figure is the hero of a data card, its label small beneath.
signature.build: Set the number in the display face at 3 to 4 times body size with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and the unit at text size on the same baseline. Use a real number from the product; if there is none, leave the card out.

signature.name: Bleeding display word
signature.what: One hand-set display word runs off the edge of the container.
signature.build: Put the word in its own element with white-space: nowrap, size it in vw so it overflows by 10 to 20 percent, and clip it with overflow: hidden on the section, never the page. Keep the full message in readable text elsewhere so nothing important is cut.

signature.name: Duotone crops
signature.what: Product photos or screenshots mapped to two palette colours.
signature.build: Apply an SVG filter (feColorMatrix to greyscale, then feComponentTransfer) that maps shadows to --text and highlights to --accent, or multiply a greyscale image over an accent layer. Keep one unfiltered image on the page so the treatment reads as a choice.

signature.name: Mono margin notes
signature.what: Short annotations in the mono face beside the paragraph they explain.
signature.build: Use a two-column grid with a 200 to 240 px note column and place each aside on the same row as its paragraph. Below 1024 px fold each note inline under its paragraph with a hairline above.

signature.name: Scroll progress rule
signature.what: A 2 px rule along the top of the viewport that fills with reading progress.
signature.build: Drive transform: scaleX() from 0 to 1 with animation-timeline: scroll() on a fixed element with transform-origin: left, and leave it hidden where scroll timelines are unsupported. It moves only with the reader's own scroll, so it may stay under reduced motion.

signature.name: Registration marks
signature.what: Thin corner crop marks around images and video.
signature.build: Draw four 12 px L-shaped marks from two background gradients per corner, offset 8 px outside the media box, in --border-strong. Use them on media only, never on cards.

signature.name: Colour-block nav band
signature.what: A solid band in the accent that carries the navigation and the product name.
signature.build: Make the header a full-width block in --accent with --accent-text links, 56 to 64 px tall, with no shadow. Start the hero directly below on --background so the band is the only colour field above the fold.

signature.name: Gutter section numerals
signature.what: Each section is numbered in the left gutter in the display face.
signature.build: Place the numeral in a narrow first grid column, aligned to the heading's cap height, in --text-muted. Number only content that is truly sequential, and never a page with one section.

signature.name: Ticking contents rail
signature.what: A sticky table of contents where one short tick marks the current section.
signature.build: Track sections with IntersectionObserver and move a single 2 px tick with translateY at 200 ms ease-out. Set aria-current on the active link so the state does not rely on colour. Show the rail at 1024 px and wider; below that the page needs no rail.

signature.name: Footnoted claims
signature.what: Claims carry superscript note numbers that link to sources at the foot of the section.
signature.build: Mark each claim with sup and a link to its note, and give every note a link back, set at 14 px in --text-muted. Footnote only real sources; without them the page does not get this signature.

signature.name: Colophon footer
signature.what: A footer that lists the typefaces, colours and build of the site like a book colophon.
signature.build: Set a short definition list in the mono face: typefaces, palette swatches as 12 px squares with their OKLCH values, and the stack. Keep it to 6 lines or fewer.

signature.name: Dot leaders
signature.what: Label and value joined by a dotted leader, like a menu or a spec sheet.
signature.build: Use a flex row of label, a flexible spacer with a radial-gradient dot background on the baseline, and the value in tabular figures. Below 390 px stack the value under its label and drop the leader.

signature.name: Running head
signature.what: A slim book-style running head that names the current section.
signature.build: Add a 32 px sticky bar under the nav whose text swaps as sections pass, tracked by IntersectionObserver, in caps at 12 to 13 px with +0.06em tracking. Swap with a 150 ms opacity fade, and instantly under reduced motion.

signature.name: Edge ruler
signature.what: A measurement ruler with ticks along one edge of the hero or a product shot.
signature.build: Draw ticks with a repeating-linear-gradient every 8 px and a longer tick every 64 px, with mono labels at each long tick. Align it to the 4 px grid so the ruler is truthful.

signature.name: Marker underline
signature.what: One phrase per page underlined with a hand-drawn marker stroke.
signature.build: Place an inline SVG path with a slight wobble under the phrase, stroke var(--accent), stroke-linecap round, behind the text inside an isolated inline-block. Draw it once with stroke-dashoffset on load, and show it static under reduced motion.

signature.name: Cut-paper shapes
signature.what: Flat geometric shapes in palette colours collaged behind and beside photos.
signature.build: Cut 2 or 3 shapes with clip-path: polygon() or SVG in --accent and a surface colour, placed on the grid and overlapping image edges by 16 to 32 px. No blur, no gradients, no looping animation.

signature.name: Halftone images
signature.what: Photos rendered with a visible halftone dot screen.
signature.build: Layer a radial-gradient dot pattern with a 4 to 6 px pitch over a high-contrast greyscale photo, blended with multiply in light and screen in dark. Keep the plain photo underneath so the page degrades to a normal image.

signature.name: Contact sheet
signature.what: Images laid out as a photographic contact sheet with frame numbers.
signature.build: Use a dense grid of equal frames with 4 px gaps on a dark strip, frame numbers in mono at 12 px under each, and one chosen frame circled in --accent. Open a frame in a dialog on click.

signature.name: Keycap shortcuts
signature.what: Keyboard shortcuts shown as real keycaps inline in copy and menus.
signature.build: Style kbd with --surface-raised, a 1 px --border-strong edge and a 2 px inset bottom shadow, mono at 12 to 13 px. Show only shortcuts that exist in the product.

signature.name: Annotated screenshot
signature.what: A real product screenshot with numbered callout dots and short notes.
signature.build: Position 3 to 5 numbered 24 px dots by percentage over the image and list the matching notes beside it. On phones move the notes under the image and keep the dots.

signature.name: Grid coordinates
signature.what: Panels and figures labelled with chart coordinates such as A1 and B3.
signature.build: Label each panel in mono at 12 px in its top-left corner and refer to the labels in copy. Label the content rather than the columns so the references survive every breakpoint.

signature.name: Double-rule totals
signature.what: Accounting-style double rules under totals and key figures.
signature.build: Put border-bottom: 3px double var(--text) under the total row and a single hairline above it. Right-align every amount in tabular figures.

signature.name: Hanging pull quote
signature.what: A pull quote in the display face with its opening mark hanging into the margin.
signature.build: Use hanging-punctuation: first where supported, with a negative text-indent of about 0.45em as the fallback. Attribute it with name and role at text size, and skip the signature when no real quote exists.

signature.name: Drop cap
signature.what: A three-line drop cap on the first paragraph of long text.
signature.build: Use initial-letter: 3 where supported, with a float and font-size fallback, set in the display face and --accent. Use one per page.

signature.name: Angled section cut
signature.what: Coloured sections end on a shallow 3 to 4 degree diagonal.
signature.build: Clip the coloured section with clip-path: polygon() so its bottom edge is the diagonal, and add bottom padding equal to the cut height. Use one angle and one direction for the whole page.

signature.name: Ticket perforation
signature.what: Cards with a perforated tear line and notched edges like a ticket stub.
signature.build: Cut the notches with a radial-gradient mask at both ends of the tear line and draw the perforation as a dotted border. Put the code or the key detail on the stub side.

signature.name: Receipt summary
signature.what: An order or plan summary styled as a printed receipt with a zigzag bottom edge.
signature.build: Set the summary in the mono face on --surface-raised and cut the bottom edge into an 8 px zigzag with a conic-gradient mask. Show the real totals and taxes; the style never carries invented data.

signature.name: Row image peek
signature.what: A list of projects or products where hovering a row shows its image beside the pointer.
signature.build: Render one absolutely positioned image that follows the pointer with transform and swaps its source per row, gated by @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine). On touch, show a small thumbnail inside each row instead.

signature.name: Rolling digits
signature.what: One changing number that rolls digit by digit like an odometer.
signature.build: Render each digit as a vertical strip of 0 to 9 inside a window 1em tall with overflow hidden and line-height 1. Give the window align-items: flex-start and the strip flex: none, or flex stretches the strip and the digits sit off their rows. Move the strip with translateY over 300 to 400 ms on the travel curve, in tabular figures. Put the plain value in an aria-live polite region; when scroll drives the value, write it there once the value settles, never per frame. Swap instantly under reduced motion.

signature.name: Masthead nameplate
signature.what: A newspaper-style nameplate with date line, issue number and rules above and below.
signature.build: Set the name in the display face between a 3 px and a 1 px rule, with the date and issue in caps at 12 px at either end. Use the real publish date and the real issue count.

signature.name: Section colour shift
signature.what: The page background changes colour as the reader enters each major section.
signature.build: Stack one fixed full-viewport layer per tone behind the content and fade the matching layer's opacity over 400 ms when IntersectionObserver reports a new chapter, swapping the text colour at the same threshold. Check contrast for every tone, and swap instantly under reduced motion.

signature.name: Folder tabs
signature.what: Section switchers drawn as file-folder tabs that join the panel below.
signature.build: Give the active tab the panel's surface colour and no bottom border so it merges with the panel, and set inactive tabs on --background with a hairline. Use role tablist with arrow-key navigation.

signature.name: Accent underline links
signature.what: Every text link carries a thick offset underline in the accent.
signature.build: Set text-decoration-thickness: 2px, text-underline-offset: 0.2em and text-decoration-color: var(--accent) while the link text stays --text. On hover switch the underline to --text with no transition.

signature.name: Spine label
signature.what: A section title set vertically along the left edge like a book spine.
signature.build: Use writing-mode: vertical-rl with rotate(180deg), in caps at 12 to 14 px, sticky within its section. Hide it below 1024 px, where the normal heading carries the name.

signature.name: Stamped status
signature.what: One key status shown as an outlined rubber stamp, slightly rotated.
signature.build: Draw a 2 px outlined box in the status colour with caps at +0.08em tracking, rotated 4 to 6 degrees, once per view. Keep a plain-text status beside it for screen readers.

signature.name: Edge-bleed sparkline tile
signature.what: Each KPI tile ends in a sparkline that runs out to its left, right and bottom edges, an area fading from the series colour to nothing.
signature.build: Make the SVG the tile's last child with margin: 0 calc(var(--pad-card) * -1) calc(var(--pad-card) * -1) and overflow: hidden on the tile so it meets the rounded corners. Draw the line in var(--chart-1) at 1.5 px with vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke and fill the area with a linearGradient from the same colour at 24 percent to 0. Plot the real last 30 points, no axes, and give the svg role="img" with an aria-label that states the trend.

signature.name: Composition bar
signature.what: A segmented bar under the lead figure splits the total into its parts in the chart colours, with a value legend beneath.
signature.build: A flex row 8 px tall with 2 px gaps and rounded ends; each segment gets flex-grow equal to its share and background var(--chart-N). Under it, a legend grid of swatch, label, amount and percent in tabular figures. Show at most six parts; with more, keep the five largest and fold the tail into one Other segment in --border-strong, listed last.

signature.name: Live status dot
signature.what: A small dot with a soft ring that pulses outward, beside anything that updates live.
signature.build: An 8 px dot in var(--success) with an ::after ring of the same colour that scales from 1 to 2.4 while fading from 0.5 to 0 over 1600 ms, linear and infinite. Put the word Live or the last update time beside it, stop the pulse when the feed pauses, and under prefers-reduced-motion keep the dot and drop the ring.

signature.name: Usage meter card
signature.what: A compact card at the foot of the sidebar shows real usage against the plan limit as a ticked meter, with one upgrade action.
signature.build: Sit it above the account row on --surface-raised with --elevation-1: a label, used over limit in tabular figures, a meter of 24 to 40 ticks filled in --accent up to the share and --wash-strong after, and one full-width button. Show it only past about 60 percent of the limit, let it be dismissed, and switch the fill to --warning above 90 percent. Use the limit the brief states; the dealer deals this signature only when the brief names a plan, limit, quota or usage, so never invent one.

signature.name: Command search field
signature.what: The top bar search reads as a command palette: a wide field with a search glyph and a keycap hint at its right end.
signature.build: A 36 px field on --well with a 1 px --border edge, a 16 px search icon, placeholder text that names what it finds, and a kbd pair showing the real shortcut (Cmd K on Apple platforms, Ctrl K elsewhere) in mono at 12 px. The shortcut opens a dialog of recent items and grouped results; hide the keycap on touch devices.

signature.name: Benchmark line
signature.what: The main chart draws a dashed benchmark or target series behind the real one and labels the latest point where the line ends.
signature.build: Draw the benchmark as a 1.5 px line with stroke-dasharray: 4 4 in var(--chart-2) under the real series in var(--chart-1) and its area gradient. End the real line on a 4 px dot with a 2 px var(--surface) ring and the value beside it in tabular figures. Name both series in a legend; the dash, not colour alone, tells them apart.

signature.name: Thirty-day heat strip
signature.what: A row of the last 30 days as small squares whose fill steps with volume, beside a name or under a count.
signature.build: A grid of 30 cells, 10 px square with 2 px gaps and 2 px radius, filled with color-mix(in oklab, var(--chart-1) N%, var(--surface)) at 20, 45, 70 and 100 percent, and empty days on --wash-strong. Give each cell a title with its date and value and label the strip with its range. One hue only; the steps of lightness carry the data.

signature.name: Avatar stack
signature.what: Overlapping avatars of the people on a record, capped by a count chip.
signature.build: Three or four 24 px circles overlapping by 8 px, each with a 2 px ring in the colour of the surface beneath so the edges stay crisp, then a chip of the same size on --surface-raised with +N in tabular figures at 12 px. Use initials on a chart colour at 20 percent when there is no photo, and list every name in the accessible label.

signature.name: Delta chips
signature.what: Every headline figure carries its change as a chip: an arrow, the signed percent and the comparison period.
signature.build: Inline flex, 20 px tall, a 12 px arrow icon and 12 px text in tabular figures, coloured var(--success) or var(--danger) on a 12 percent tint of the same colour, then "vs last month" in --text-muted. The sign and arrow carry direction as well as colour. When falling is good (costs, churn) swap the colours, never the arrow.

signature.name: Tile corner action
signature.what: Each KPI tile names its metric top left and carries a small raised button top right that opens the detail.
signature.build: A 28 px square button on --surface-raised with --elevation-1, a 16 px icon at 1.5 px stroke and a radius one step below the tile's. It is a real control: it links to the metric's page or opens its menu, with an aria-label that names the metric.

signature.name: Donut with centre total
signature.what: A ring chart with the total set large in its centre and a legend that carries the values and shares.
signature.build: An SVG of circles with one stroke-dasharray segment per part in var(--chart-1) to var(--chart-6), 12 to 16 px thick with 2 px gaps and round caps, starting at 12 o'clock. Centre the total in the display face at 28 to 40 px over a 12 px label. The legend rows hold swatch, name, amount and percent in tabular figures so the ring never has to be read alone.

signature.name: Period bar ticks
signature.what: A KPI tile with a strip of thin bars for the last 12 periods, the latest bar in full colour and the rest held back.
signature.build: Twelve bars 4 to 6 px wide with 3 px gaps and 2 px radius, heights from real values, bottom-aligned in a 32 px row beside the figure. Fill them with var(--chart-1) at 35 percent and the latest at 100 percent. The figure repeats the latest value, so mark the strip aria-hidden.

signature.name: Joined range control
signature.what: The page header joins the date range and the granularity into one segmented control beside the primary action.
signature.build: Two buttons inside one 36 px outline with a 1 px divider: a calendar icon and the real range (18 Feb to 18 Mar) that opens a range picker, and the granularity (Daily, Weekly, Monthly) that opens a menu. A change refetches every tile and shows skeletons in place, never a page spinner.

signature.name: Dot-grid chart ground
signature.what: Charts sit on a faint dot grid instead of gridlines, with axis labels in muted tabular figures.
signature.build: Paint the plot area with radial-gradient(circle, var(--wash-strong) 1px, transparent 1.5px) sized to the tick spacing so the dots land on the ticks, masked to fade at the edges, and keep one solid baseline at zero. Axis labels at 12 px in --text-muted with tabular figures.

signature.name: Attention chips
signature.what: Under the page title, chips name the few things that need action now, each a link to the filtered list.
signature.build: Pills 32 px tall with an icon, a count in tabular figures and a short phrase ("3 renewals due this week"). The urgent one sits on var(--warning) at 14 percent with --warning text; the rest sit on --surface-raised. Show at most three, only from real counts, and hide the row when nothing needs action.

signature.name: Crosshair readout
signature.what: Hovering a time chart draws a vertical guide and a tooltip that stacks every series value at that point.
signature.build: Track pointermove on the plot, snap to the nearest point, draw a 1 px var(--border-strong) guide with a 6 px dot on each series, and show a tooltip on --surface-raised with --elevation-2 listing swatch, name and value in tabular figures. When the chart has focus the arrow keys move the point, and the same values go to an aria-live region.
